:''Many of these settings are covered in detail [[Technical_tricks#Settings_-_init.txt|here]].''

The '''init.txt''' file can be used to make many adjustments to the game presentation and feel, like changing [[Technical tricks#Screen_sizes|screen size]], or enabling [[Tilesets]]. Other options that would [[Technical tricks|improve framerate]] by deactivating features are contained in [[d_init.txt]].

This file is located at '''Dwarf Fortress/data/init/init.txt''' ('''~/.dwarffortress/data/init/init.txt''' on Arch Linux if ''Dwarf Fortress'' was installed through <tt>pacman</tt>) along with the embark profiles, [[d_init.txt]], and other useful files.
